parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Rearrange to $4\sin^2x=6\cos^2x$, hence $\tan^2x=\frac64$ (**M1**; equivalent forms allowed). Obtain one correct angle, $x=50.8^\circ$ (**A1**; $0.886$ rad allowed), then another correct angle (**A1**, follow-through). Give all four angles $50.8^\circ,129.2^\circ,230.8^\circ,309.2^\circ$ (**A1**; radians $0.886,2.25,4.03,5.40$ allowed).
